test_title: PYST 39: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter cluster.

COMFORT : FMOCTRO :: DIGNITY : NGIDYTI :: FOREIGN : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First four letters → Written diagonally.
 
• Last three letters → Written diagonally.

So,

 
• COMFORT : FMOCTRO

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00a8a6979d1e30f9fb1c0aac26ca50e5e540010b4bd600e9f297411c5e8d6b99.png] 

And,

 
• DIGNITY : NGIDYTI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bca8d60a89ebbaeb9f3a05da4e8e849516446bb97b797e6e1cdb450222d8d9d.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• FOREIGN : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcc8351fa5647abd2611c660b185d1eca313f2a0e6dca2d2394e24c1821f87a2.png] 

​Hence, the correct answer is "**EROFNGI**".

5a
